hint.en: +4 BP. Ask Lao at the counter, Bloom on the 2F of the general store and Rhett in the apartment next to the bar; read the recipe book in Rhett's room. Everything can be bought except 2 Monster Bone (Dirty Rat, Crop Muncher). Rewards the Spiced Stew recipe.
hint.pt: +4 BP. Pergunte ao Lao no balcão, à Bloom no 2F do armazém e ao Rhett no apartamento ao lado do bar; leia o livro de receitas no quarto do Rhett. Tudo pode ser comprado, menos 2 Monster Bone (Dirty Rat, Crop Muncher). A recompensa é a receita Spiced Stew.

sources: guide: GameFAQs SC walkthrough by shockinblue, Chapter 5 - Day 1

location.en: Rolent — top of the clock tower
location.pt: Rolent — topo da torre do relógio

hint.en: +4 BP. Hand Anton 5 Monster Shell (Russet Beetle), 5 Monster Seed (Lily Mover, Pine Plant), 5 Monster Powder (Garphase, Killer Hornet) and 1 Pearlglass (fish it on Milch Main Road or Elize Highway). Olivier has to step out of the party for a moment.
hint.pt: +4 BP. Entregue ao Anton 5 Monster Shell (Russet Beetle), 5 Monster Seed (Lily Mover, Pine Plant), 5 Monster Powder (Garphase, Killer Hornet) e 1 Pearlglass (pesque na Milch Main Road ou na Elize Highway). O Olivier precisa sair da equipe por um momento.

sources: guide: GameFAQs SC walkthrough by shockinblue, Chapter 5 - Day 1

location.pt: Rolent — residência do Mine Chief Garton

hint.en: +5 BP. Clues: the chair on the chapel balcony upstairs, the crates on the south side of the Mayor's house, the forge behind the arms shop, then the locked door in Rolent Sewers (fight inside; the document is on the table).
hint.pt: +5 BP. Pistas: a cadeira na sacada do andar de cima da capela, as caixas no lado sul da casa do prefeito, a forja atrás da loja de armas e, por fim, a porta trancada no Rolent Sewers (luta lá dentro; o documento está na mesa).

sources: guide: GameFAQs SC walkthrough by shockinblue, Chapter 5 - Day 1

hint.en: +5 BP. Clues: the basket of red flowers outside the 2F door of the orbal factory, the desk with an open book on the guild 3F, the crate on the forklift at the landing port, and the book on the altar upstairs in the chapel (side door).
hint.pt: +5 BP. Pistas: a cesta de flores vermelhas do lado de fora da porta do 2F da fábrica orbal, a mesa com um livro aberto no 3F da guilda, a caixa na empilhadeira do porto e o livro no altar do andar de cima da capela (porta lateral).

sources: guide: GameFAQs SC walkthrough by shockinblue, Chapter 5 - Day 1

hint.en: 4 +2 BP. Deliver 10 each of Monster Horn, Fang, Shell, Bone, Tail, Eye, Fish Meat and Roe. Orvid, outside the market's south entrance, chips in 7 of each, so you only need 3 more of each; you still get the bonus.
hint.pt: 4 +2 BP. Entregue 10 de cada: Monster Horn, Fang, Shell, Bone, Tail, Eye, Fish Meat e Roe. O Orvid, do lado de fora da entrada sul do mercado, contribui com 7 de cada, então só faltam 3 de cada; o bônus continua valendo.

sources: guide: GameFAQs SC walkthrough by shockinblue, Chapter 5 - Day 1

hint.en: 4 +1 BP. Leads to Krone Pass. When talking to the girl there, pick the option that calls her a coward.
hint.pt: 4 +1 BP. Leva à Krone Pass. Ao falar com a garota lá, escolha a opção que a chama de covarde.

strategy.en: Huge HP and little else. They sometimes confuse themselves; each survives one lethal hit, so keep a follow-up ready.
strategy.pt: Muito HP e pouco mais. Às vezes eles se confundem sozinhos; cada um sobrevive a um golpe letal, então tenha um ataque extra pronto.

sources: guide: GameFAQs SC walkthrough by shockinblue, Chapter 5 - Day 1

strategy.en: Petrify and Burn protection; high-tier fire arts work well. Their basic attack drains HP, EP and CP.
strategy.pt: Proteção contra Petrify e Burn; arts de fogo fortes funcionam bem. O ataque básico deles drena HP, EP e CP.

sources: guide: GameFAQs SC walkthrough by shockinblue, Chapter 5 - Day 1

strategy.en: Bring Freeze and Petrify protection (Red Sphere+ covers both) and strong wind arts. Keep Earth Guard up and some CP to steal its zero-arts bonus.
strategy.pt: Leve proteção contra Freeze e Petrify (a Red Sphere+ cobre os dois) e arts de vento fortes. Mantenha o Earth Guard e guarde CP para roubar o bônus de arts instantâneas.

sources: guide: GameFAQs SC walkthrough by shockinblue, Chapter 5 - Day 1

strategy.en: Lots of HP; bring Petrify protection and wind arts.
strategy.pt: Muito HP; leve proteção contra Petrify e arts de vento.

sources: guide: GameFAQs SC walkthrough by shockinblue, Chapter 5 - Day 2

strategy.en: Big but not hard. Get behind its head for back-attack bonuses, resist Blind and Burn, shield the party after its half-HP scene, and strip its boost with Anti-Sept.
strategy.pt: Grande, mas não difícil. Vá para trás da cabeça para ganhar bônus de ataque pelas costas, resista a Blind e Burn, proteja a equipe com escudo depois da cena na metade do HP e remova o reforço com Anti-Sept.

sources: guide: GameFAQs SC walkthrough by shockinblue, Chapter 5 - Day 2
